title: Phase 12 — BASELINE-DEFECT-02 Assessment (assessment only; NO code change made)

presentInSHA: the test code is present in candidate 7e063b4; the PRODUCT endpoint (employee-profile summary) is unchanged and healthy.
productionImpact: NONE — this is a test-harness/fixture contamination artifact, not a product regression. The employee-profile summary endpoint behaves correctly (proven by the passing test on clean serialized DB).
severity: low (test-only, non-reproducing on clean serialized DB)
workaround: run integration collections serialized (parallelizeTestCollections=false) or run isolated collections separately — already applied for the authoritative measurement.
fixMade: NONE — per ticket, if a fix would require a code change it must NOT be made here; a test-fixture hardening (assert each step in SubmitEvalAsync, mirroring the BASELINE-DEFECT-01 close) is a code change and is therefore deferred to a dedicated test-isolation ticket, not this readiness ticket.
ticketNeeded: yes — existing queued ticket 'عزل اختبار لـBASELINE-DEFECT-02 وحده' remains the owner.
